履修条件
Graduate students who have an undergraduate-level background in science and engineering.
The students need to go to Busan, Korea in August 2026 to take this course.
授業概要
このコースを受講することにより、企業見学やフィールドトリップに参加できます。 後半では、修士研究（博士課程の場合は博士研究）を発表する必要があります。
このコースは英語のみで行われます。
In this course, graduate students may participate in industry tours and feild trips. In the latter half of this course, the students need to present their master’s research (or doctoral research if he or she is a doctoral course student).
This course will be given by English only.

全体の教育目標
The overall aim of this course is for students to learn about topical issues, current state of the industry, as well as to present their research in the fields of energy and environmental science and technology. In addition, CAMPUS Asia plus program DD course students need to present their master’s (or doctoral) research progress to pass the mid-term evaluation.
個別の教育目標
This course is specifically aimed at helping students to broaden their horizons and improve their presentation skills in the fields of energy and environmental science and engineering in an informative, engaging, and professional manner.
授業計画
This course will be given in the Summer School of CAMPUS Asia plus program (CA+), which will be held in the latter half of August 2026, in Pusan National University, Korea
The course may consist of feild trips and industry tours.
In the latter half of this course, the students need to present their research in the fields of energy and environmental science and technology.
In the presentations, CA+ DD course students need to introduce their master’s (or doctoral) research progress to pass the mid-term evaluation reviewed by all professors come from CA+ partner universities.
The course details will be announced before the middle of August 2026.
This course will be given by English only.
